observing.naked_eye: Not normally identifiable as a distinct object to the unaided eye.
observing.binoculars: Usually stellar or nearly stellar in binoculars; careful comparison with nearby stars is the key. The field lies within the Almanack's visible Milky Way boundary, so the background is especially star-rich.
observing.telescope: Moderate to high power reveals the small nebular disk or ring-like structure; a nebula filter can help separate it from the stellar field.
